A '''giant star''' was a type of [[Star/Legends|star]]. They usually generated less heat than smaller stars, and the outer [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was explorable using a well-shielded [[Scout ship/Legends|scout vessel]]. Giant stars typically occurred when the [[Hydrogen/Legends|hydrogen]] fuel of the star had been consumed, causing the star to expand, possibly consuming inner [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in a [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Systems with giant stars were capable of supporting terrestrial planets. [[Red giant/Legends|Red giants]] were the most common form of giant star.

As the star aged, it would vary in size and brightness. As it continued to burn, it would produce heavier elements until it exhausted it fuel. At that point, it would collapse into a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] or [[Neutron star/Legends|neutron star]]. The outer layers had a chance of creating a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. On rare occasions, the giant star's core could become a [[Black dwarf/Legends|black dwarf]].
